en: This black and white postcard depicts two women in traditional dress working at a loom, inside a rustic and well-lit room with plants on the window sill and lace curtains. The women are wearing traditional Scandinavian clothing, likely from the early 20th century. The text in the corner indicates the scene is from 'Uddevallautställningen 1928' and lists 'Bohus-stugan.'
